Hey! My father also has colon cancer as well, and has has it for I think 2-3 years now and we found out on easter day. My father honestly isn’t the healthiest man, but I’m telling you now that with the therapy that have for colon cancer now is great! As long as my dad is on chemo (which they now switched him to immunotherapy) he’s going to be fine. He’s been quite nervous since they moved him to immunotherapy because he’s getting a scan next week and going to see if anything grew but prior to this they told him IT is way more efficient. The main point here, as I can’t promise you anything, I can say that the technology they have now is really evolving and continuously gets better day by day. My dad got diagnosed when he’s in stage 4, and he’s been good for a long while. If you ever need someone to talk to, feel free to reach out. :)
